target: autonomous-auto pipeline visibility and stage-evidence timing
summary: During the Azoth Harness Operating Profile Decision campaign, the child scope and write claim were opened correctly, but stage evidence was not recorded before evidence synthesis began. The operator reasonably asked whether any pipeline was being used, revealing a visibility failure: the loop was mechanically active, but the pipeline was not legible at the moment the operator checked.
mistake: Opened an autonomous-auto child scope and began campaign evidence synthesis before recording explicit run-ledger inline exception and stage-summary evidence for the declared delegation_plan stages.
root_cause: The orchestrator treated scope-gate/open-next success as enough pipeline activation and relied on later completion evidence, instead of making the stage plan visible immediately after child open. Host policy also forbids spawned subagents unless explicitly requested, which increased the need for early inline-exception records; that need was recognized late.
evidence: `run_ledger.py status` showed active run `2026-05-05-autonomous-auto-azoth-harness-operating-profile-decision-1`, active stage `autonomous_auto_s1_architect`, and a held write claim, while the operator still could not see a staged pipeline in progress because stage evidence had not yet been recorded. After the correction, `record-inline-exception` and `record-summary` were recorded for `autonomous_auto_s1_architect`.
recommended_action: Plant a later autonomous-auto self-improvement campaign to make pipeline visibility fail-closed or at least immediately legible: after `open-next`, the orchestrator should record planned stage activation or inline-exception intent before doing substantive synthesis, and status/operator reads should expose the active stage plan plus evidence gaps clearly.

later_campaign_seed.title: Autonomous-auto pipeline visibility preflight and stage-evidence timing repair
later_campaign_seed.goal: Discover and fix why autonomous-auto can look pipeline-less after scope open; require an immediate visible stage-evidence checkpoint after `open-next` and before substantive campaign work.
acceptance_criteria: Operator-read status shows active child stage plan and whether each stage has spawn, inline-exception, or summary evidence.
A missing first-stage evidence record is caught before substantive campaign synthesis proceeds.
Inline execution remains allowed only with explicit reason when host policy prevents spawning.
No fake subagent evidence is backfilled.
Focused tests cover child-open -> evidence-visible behavior and missing-evidence failure mode.

ux_anchor_scorecard.boundary: mechanical pipeline active but not visible early enough
